headline: Executive order from 1997 bars new investment in Burma (Myanmar).
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order prohibits new investment in Burma, the country now also called Myanmar. No summary was provided, so details such as exact rules, exceptions, and penalties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would be barred from making new investments in Burma.
They would lose access to new investment from those covered by the ban.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 20, 1997; the exact start date is not stated in the provided material.
